radiant.text:
Indestructible
Start of game: Gain one of 13 random powers. Each is an Activate that spends its (X).
(3) Expedition Map: Recruit a permanent. Make it Radiant.
(1) Life Tap: Draw 1 from each player's deck.

(2) Die Insect: Lucky 1. Deal 8 damage to a random enemy.
(2) KY Brainstorm: Add a Radiant KY card to your hand. Reduce the cost of all Spells in your hand by (1).
(2) Pluck: Add a random Radiant Fruit to your hand. It costs (0).
